records.attempted_claim: Derive the NS-CI-R014-A2 critical-integrability bridge through the L4 weighted active-diagonal route using only Lambda in L2_t, Leray energy/dissipation budgets, fixed-shell balance, signed transfer conservation, and the strict-high threshold.

assumptions: Whole-space unforced three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes with positive viscosity.
The dissipation wavenumber satisfies Lambda in L2_t.
Only the audited fixed-shell, selector, signed-transfer, commutator, and strict-high interfaces are available.
included_variants: Positive weighted shell kernels below the active cutoff.
Signed nearest-neighbour transfer and active-set boundary ledgers.
excluded_variants: A new PDE theorem supplying active-set variation, selected-transfer cancellation, depletion, commutator closure, or triadic decorrelation.
The independent L5 direct critical-integral decomposition.

method.description: Exact selector-weighted shell identities, commutator audit, and a conservative nearest-neighbour shell-and-packet counterfixture.

result.summary: The L4 route is exhausted under the audited interfaces because active selection destroys signed telescoping, Lambda in L2_t does not control weighted active-set variation, and an exact shell fixture preserves the available budgets while the active diagonal diverges.
result.smallest_known_witness: Conservative nearest-neighbour shell-and-packet fixture in the protected L4-4 work package.
does_not_establish: Falsity of the Navier-Stokes regularity claim.
Failure of the independent L5 route.
Impossibility under a genuinely new equation-specific theorem.

excluded_variants: Reusing the audited L4 interfaces without a new PDE theorem.
non_excluded_variants: A new equation-specific cancellation, depletion, commutator, variation, or decorrelation theorem.

requirements: Provide a complete proof of active-set variation, selected-transfer cancellation, active-diagonal depletion, non-circular commutator control, or triadic decorrelation.
Bind the new theorem to exact source and review identities.
Show why the protected nearest-neighbour fixture is excluded by an actual Navier-Stokes identity.

records.attempted_claim: Find a nontrivial counterexample to Frankl's union-closed sets conjecture on universes of cardinality at most four by exact enumeration.

assumptions: Universe cardinality n is at most four.
The exact enumeration and certificate semantics are those of the pinned MATHSOLVE WP04 package.
Only nontrivial union-closed families in the enumerated finite search space are considered.
included_variants: All exact enumerated nontrivial union-closed families on universes n <= 4.
excluded_variants: Any universal analytic proof of Frankl's conjecture.

method.description: Exact Python enumeration with a hashed certificate artifact and independent replay.

result.summary: The finite search space was exhausted and no Frankl violation was found for universes n <= 4.
does_not_establish: Absence of counterexamples outside the exact enumerated search space.

excluded_variants: A counterexample within the exact n <= 4 enumeration and certificate semantics.
non_excluded_variants: A defect in the enumerator or certificate semantics established by new evidence.
Universal proof or refutation by another route.

requirements: Supply a reproducible defect in the exact enumerator or certificate semantics, or a counterexample within n <= 4.
For a larger search, create a successor record with a strictly expanded finite scope rather than mutating this record.

records.attempted_claim: Apply GCL tooling validation unconditionally from the Programme policy-reachability validator without distinguishing repositories or synthetic fixtures that have no tooling control surface.

assumptions: Policy-reachability tests may construct reduced synthetic repositories.
A tooling control is applicable only when its control surface is present.
Partial control surfaces must fail closed, while a wholly absent surface must not invalidate unrelated fixtures.
included_variants: The unconditional integration at exact head 3c8f44a9fce611e63745494018d992721148aa6c.
excluded_variants: The repaired absent/complete/partial surface discrimination merged in PR #205.

method.description: Hosted Programme policy replay against the exact PR head and reduced synthetic policy fixtures.

result.summary: The unconditional integration broke reduced synthetic policy fixtures after the repository tests had otherwise passed. The defect was repaired by validating tooling only when the control surface is present and by rejecting partial surfaces explicitly.
result.smallest_known_witness: The synthetic repository in ci/test_policy_reachability.py containing no GCL tooling files.
does_not_establish: A defect in the final protected tooling tranche.
A failure of manifest or identity validation semantics.

excluded_variants: Reintroducing unconditional tooling validation that treats absent and partial control surfaces identically.
non_excluded_variants: Future tooling controls with equivalent fail-closed conditional integration.
